description: TriageResult — the only thing that crosses L3 DECIDE-1 → L4 DECIDE-2 (contract C3). kind is a TYPED ENUM, not a string: the stringly-typed correlation kinds ('new'|'duplicate'|'storm'|...) are exactly the defect class deterministic-gate.md §2.4 names for the disposition vocabulary, so the contract types them at the boundary. Mapping from today's CorrelationResult.kind: 'storm' (folded into an active storm) → 'storm_fold'; 'label_stale' does NOT appear here — it travels the parallel page_sink output (D7), never this boundary. Enum-extensibility rule (from the kore1 enum-addition incident — see README): new members are additive, but consumers MUST NOT fail on unknown members; the mandated mapping is fail toward 'new' semantics (full gate evaluation — never toward suppression). Silence/dedup on an unknown kind would be fail-silent; this contract forbids it.

episode_ref.description: Reference to the episode this triage belongs to. Draft format '<fingerprint>:<episode-opened-unix-ts>' (v0.1: opaque to the consumer; normalized in v0.2+). Present even for kind=new — the episode is opened by the triage.

fingerprint.description: The alert's canonical fingerprint (ADR-017 v2). Ties the triage back to the Alert that produced it.

flap_count.description: Present when kind=reopened: the episode relapse count (ADR-001). Reopen bumps flap_count but never auto-promotes severity — the alert still goes through the full gate.

kind.description: Typed triage outcome. new: first sighting / fresh episode → full gate evaluation. duplicate: inside the dedup window → inherits prior_disposition, no Jev call. change_window: matched a change window (non-P1/P2 only) → business-hours paging. storm_fold: folded into an active storm → absorbed into the aggregate page, explicitly NOT suppression (D3). reopened: flap after resolve → full gate evaluation with flap_count visible.

prior_disposition.description: Present only when kind=duplicate: the disposition to inherit without a Jev call. Vocabulary pinned by C4 (pending-R9-ratification); v0.1 treats it as opaque passthrough — action/reason carried, never reinterpreted.

storm_declared.description: Present only when kind=storm_fold: true on the ingest that declared the storm, false for later folds (mirrors CorrelationResult.storm_declared).

title: TriageResult — deterministic pre-Jev triage outcome (contract C3)
